stem: To which of the following is Abigail Adams referring in this excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: The American victory at the Battle of Yorktown

options.label: B
options.text: The negotiation of the Treaty of Paris by American diplomats

options.label: C
options.text: The bravery of American soldiers at Valley Forge

options.label: D
options.text: The arrival of French aid after the Battle of Saratoga

visual_elements: America may boast that she has accomplished what no power before her ever did, contending with Britain—Captured two of their celebrated Generals and each an Army of thousands of veteran Troops to support them. —Abigail Adams, letter to John Adams, December 9, 1781
